meta_description: SharpKeys Birmingham offers emergency locksmith services across the city. Fast response times, professional lock repairs and replacements. Call us now.
hero_subhead: We're here round the clock. Get back inside your home or business in under 30 minutes, any time of day or night.
services_heading: Emergency & Routine Locksmith Services in Birmingham
services_subhead: From lockouts and break-ins to new lock installation and key cutting, we handle every lock problem fast.

services.title: Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked out of your home, office, or vehicle? We arrive quickly and gain entry without damage to your door or frame. Available 24/7, every day of the year.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Damaged locks, broken keys, or worn mechanisms? We repair or replace your locks on the spot with quality hardware that lasts.

services.title: Security Door Locks
services.desc: Upgrade to modern mortice locks, cylinder locks, or multipoint systems. We fit premium locks that meet British Standard BS 3621 for added peace of mind.

services.title: Burglar Damage Entry
services.desc: Forced doors or windows after a break-in? We open up securely so you can inspect the damage, then fit emergency boarding or temporary locks while you arrange repairs.

services.title: Key Cutting & Duplication
services.desc: Need spare keys cut? We provide fast, precise key cutting for house, office, and vehicle keys using modern laser equipment.

services.title: Padlock Services
services.desc: Padlock stuck, lost key, or need a new one? We remove damaged padlocks and install secure replacements for gates, sheds, and storage.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I got locked out myself at midnight and waited hours.
about_para_1: SharpKeys has been serving Birmingham residents and businesses for 18 years. What started as a one-person operation has grown into a trusted emergency locksmith service covering the whole city. We've completed over 2,000 emergency callouts and built our reputation on simple promise: we arrive fast, we fix your problem properly, and we don't overcharge.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we treat their lockout like an emergency—not just another job. We carry stock of quality locks on every van, we explain what we're doing, and we leave your home or business secure. Whether it's 3am on a Sunday or a Tuesday afternoon, you get the same professional service and fair pricing.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Customers Say About SharpKeys

reviews.text: Locked myself out at 2am and genuinely didn't know who to call. SharpKeys arrived in 25 minutes. The locksmith was friendly, knew exactly what he was doing, and had me back inside in ten minutes flat. Saved my life. Fair price too given the time of night.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: After a break-in, the police said I needed to secure the property immediately. SharpKeys got to me within an hour, changed the locks, and made everything secure again. Professional and no fuss. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Michelle T.

reviews.text: My son got locked in the bathroom and we panicked. Called SharpKeys and they talked me through how to let him out safely, then came round to fix the lock so it won't happen again. Great service, great bloke.
reviews.author: Robert H.
